academic-thesis-workflow 1.0.1

- No code or content changes; documentation files are unchanged.
- No user-visible updates in this release.

Academic Thesis Workflow v1.0.0

- Initial release of a standardized, reproducible 4-step academic thesis workflow supporting all disciplines (humanities, social sciences, STEM).
- Guides users from thesis topic to full academic paper through: feasibility evaluation, argument structure generation with research direction derivation, structure optimization, and final paper drafting with automated 5-dimensional review.
- Integrates sample-based and prompt-driven generation, with sector-specific adaptation for humanities/social sciences and STEM subjects.
- Includes built-in protocols and academic standards for consistent, norm-compliant output (citation style GB/T 7714; Chinese language).
- Bundles reference documents: sample outlines, full sample paper, and background methodology guide for context-aware generation.
